name: Node View Language Permissions
description: Adds per-content-type, per-language 'view own/any content' permissions, enforced via the node-grants system.
project_description:
This module enables permissions "View own content" and "View any content" for each content type per language on permissions page. 

 The permissions lists will be very long, if you have many languages and content types. 

 It is an extended version of Node View Permissions 

 Configuration 
 
 Set Permissions in People » Permissions » Node view language permissions 
 Rebuild permissions in Reports » Node access permissions 
 
 Read README.txt for more information.
